name: lunantishee

attributes.attribute: the fairy of the blackthorn tree

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The lunantishee is a being of Irish folklore. It is the fairy of the blackthorn, or thorn, tree. The blackthorn is a tree the Irish fairy folk admire. The lunantishee was most active on the feasts that open summer and winter. Those feasts are Lughnasa and Samhain. Lughnasa falls on the first of August. Samhain falls on the first of November.

okr.objective: Present the lunantishee as the fairy of the blackthorn tree.
